# Requirements Document: What an answer means

## Introduction

How each response on each kind of card is recorded, and how big a moment the screen makes of it.

Each criterion carries where it comes from. *modelled* means the sentence was computed by running the model. *proven* means Lean checked a theorem for every input, shown with its statement. *open question* means the model shows a problem and someone has to decide.

## Requirements

### Requirement RG-003

**Title:** Recording a response

**User Story:** As a modeller, I want every response to mean one thing, so that answers can be compared across experts.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a prediction card THE SYSTEM SHALL record a same call.
   - RG-003.1, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a confirmation card THE SYSTEM SHALL record a same call.
   - RG-003.2, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a decision card THE SYSTEM SHALL send the decision to the area owner.
   - RG-003.3, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a check card, which holds a rule changed to be wrong THE SYSTEM SHALL record a missed check card and say nothing about it.
   - RG-003.4, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a follow-up card, computed from the last answer THE SYSTEM SHALL record a same call.
   - RG-003.5, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
6. WHEN the expert agrees with the rulebook on a card that compares the rules with the code THE SYSTEM SHALL send the decision to the area owner.
   - RG-003.6, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
7. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a prediction card THE SYSTEM SHALL tag a possible catch for the area owner.
   - RG-003.7, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
8. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a confirmation card THE SYSTEM SHALL tag a possible catch for the area owner.
   - RG-003.8, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
9. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a decision card THE SYSTEM SHALL send the decision to the area owner.
   - RG-003.9, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
10. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a check card, which holds a rule changed to be wrong THE SYSTEM SHALL record a passed check card.
   - RG-003.10, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
11. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a follow-up card, computed from the last answer THE SYSTEM SHALL tag a possible catch for the area owner.
   - RG-003.11, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
12. WHEN the expert disagrees with the rulebook on a card that compares the rules with the code THE SYSTEM SHALL send the decision to the area owner.
   - RG-003.12, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
13. WHEN the expert says it depends THE SYSTEM SHALL record an exception for the area owner.
   - RG-003.13, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
14. WHEN the expert says it is not their area THE SYSTEM SHALL route the case to its owner and show no result.
   - RG-003.14, modelled
   - Read by running `judge` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:22), and checked in every engine by the vectors
15. THE SYSTEM SHALL treat It depends and Not my area the same way on every kind of card.
   - RG-003.15, proven
   - Theorem `escapes_mean_the_same` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:52)
   - Lean: `∀ (k : Game.CardKind), Game.judge k Game.Response.depends = Game.Outcome.exception ∧ Game.judge k Game.Response.notMine = Game.Outcome.routed`

### Requirement RG-004

**Title:** The size of each moment

**User Story:** As a modeller, I want disagreement to be the biggest moment, so that the game does not teach experts to agree.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the outcome is a same call THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 1 out of 3.
   - RG-004.1, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. WHEN the outcome is a possible catch THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 3 out of 3.
   - RG-004.2, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. WHEN the outcome is a exception THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 1 out of 3.
   - RG-004.3, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. WHEN the outcome is a decision sent THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 2 out of 3.
   - RG-004.4, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. WHEN the outcome is a passed check THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 3 out of 3.
   - RG-004.5, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
6. WHEN the outcome is a missed check THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 0 out of 3.
   - RG-004.6, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
7. WHEN the outcome is a routed THE SYSTEM SHALL make a moment of size 0 out of 3.
   - RG-004.7, modelled
   - Read by running `Outcome.loudness` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:33), and checked in every engine by the vectors
8. THE SYSTEM SHALL make no moment bigger than a possible catch.
   - RG-004.8, proven
   - Theorem `catch_is_loudest` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:40)
   - Lean: `∀ (o : Game.Outcome), o.loudness ≤ Game.Outcome.possibleCatch.loudness`
9. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a same call a smaller moment than a possible catch.
   - RG-004.9, proven
   - Theorem `same_call_is_quieter_than_catch` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:44)
   - Lean: `Game.Outcome.sameCall.loudness < Game.Outcome.possibleCatch.loudness`
10. THE SYSTEM SHALL make It depends the same size of moment as a same call.
   - RG-004.10, proven
   - Theorem `depends_is_as_loud_as_same_call` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:48)
   - Lean: `Game.Outcome.exception.loudness = Game.Outcome.sameCall.loudness`
11. WHEN an expert misses a check card THE SYSTEM SHALL make no moment of it.
   - RG-004.11, proven
   - Theorem `missed_check_is_silent` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:57)
   - Lean: `Game.Outcome.checkMissed.loudness = 0`

### Requirement RG-011

**Title:** Sides and follow-ups

**User Story:** As a modeller, I want a habit of swiping one way to show no pattern of agreement, so that an answer means something.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep yes on the right on yes or no cards.
   - RG-011.1, proven
   - Theorem `yes_stays_on_the_right` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:78)
   - Lean: `∀ (k : Game.CardKind) (seed index : Nat), k.yesStaysRight = true → Game.sidesSwapped k seed index = false`
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL place a prediction card's answers on opposite sides for consecutive seeds.
   - RG-011.2, proven
   - Theorem `sides_balance_across_seeds` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:82)
   - Lean: `∀ (seed index : Nat), (Game.sidesSwapped Game.CardKind.predict seed index != Game.sidesSwapped Game.CardKind.predict (seed + 1) index) = true`
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL show a follow-up only when the expert made a call on the case it follows.
   - RG-011.3, proven
   - Theorem `follow_up_needs_a_call` (model/Game/Outcome.lean:65)
   - Lean: `∀ (r : Game.Response), Game.followUpShown r = true ↔ r = Game.Response.agrees ∨ r = Game.Response.differs`
